rules.statement: Under the Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, section 35, when immovable property gifted by a deceased person is brought into collation, the legal title to it continues with the donee and does not vest in the administrator of the donor's estate.
rules.supporting_quote: "When immovable property which was the subject-matter of a donation is brought into collation under section 35 of the Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, the legal title to it continues to remain with the donee and does not vest in the administrator of the deceased donor's estate."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance (Cap. 47), s. 35.
